name: Hana Monogatari - Natsu
source:
Main character is the son of girls school president. He spends the summer administering the girls dormitory. Even though it's summer time, seven girls remain in the building. Can this situation lead to a new feeling to be born?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是女子学校校长的儿子。他整个夏天都在管理女生宿舍。尽管是夏天，大楼里仍留有七名女孩。这种情况是否会导致新的感情诞生呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
